title: Webcam corner
description: Corner of the scene for the webcam slot. Left corners mirror the scene: the side column moves left and the gameplay window right.

title: Webcam size
description: Webcam slot: small = 440×248 (16:9), medium = 440×330 (4:3), large = 440×440 (1:1). The slot is a transparent frame; place your OBS webcam source under it (turn on alignment guides to read exact coordinates).

title: Streamer handle
description: Name shown under the webcam. Leave empty to use the osu! profile name.

title: Social text
description: Short text beside the handle, e.g. twitch.tv/name · x.com/name. Leave empty to hide.

title: Backdrop
description: Fill around the gameplay window and webcam: grid = graphite with a drafting grid, solid = plain graphite, none = transparent (panels float over a full-screen capture). The gameplay window and webcam slot are always fully transparent.

title: Show webcam frame
description: Off removes the webcam slot; the side column starts at the top.

title: Show handle caption
description: Handle and social text attached to the webcam frame.

title: Show gameplay frame
description: Hairline and corner marks around the gameplay window.

title: Show now playing
description: Map title, artist, difficulty, stats and progress in the bottom deck.

title: Show live play strip
description: PP now and if FC, accuracy, combo, UR and mods while playing; pp by accuracy in song select.

title: Show results band
description: Grade, pp, accuracy, max combo and judgements on the results screen.

title: Show player card
description: Profile name, country, global rank, pp, accuracy, level and play count.

title: Show session stats
description: Plays and playtime from vosu, plus pp and global rank change since this source loaded.

title: Show status rail
description: Connection dot, game state and ruleset under the gameplay window.

title: Alignment guides
description: Setup aid: labels the gameplay window and webcam slot with their exact pixel position and size. Turn off before going live.
